run_randsent_downstream: run the randsent module with a borep model on downstream SentEval tasks using argparse CLI
run_randsent_probing: run the randsent module with an esn model on probing SentEval tasks using argparse CLI
get_results_network: get results by creating a BOREP, ESN, or RandLSTM network and evaluating on SentEval tasks
consolidate_eval_results: consolidate SentEval task results across multiple seeds into dev and test accuracy or Pearson scores
prepare_word_embeddings: prepare word embeddings by building a word-to-id lookup and loading pretrained or random vectors
